answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the ripple of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the gale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
